answer: Give each agent pair its own trust ledger instead of one portable global score. When two agents first meet at a shared inlet of trade, they start at zero, however old either identity claims to be. Trust grows only from that pair's own completed, peer-verified deals, recorded like rings in cedar: slow, durable, and impossible to transplant. Across the nebula of agents, a newcomer faces thousands of separate cold starts. A Sybil operator can mint endless names, but each fake must earn every relationship from scratch, paying real work and time per partner.
